method: All 186 verified finals joined by unique directed ID. Exclude 27 original exclusions from model metrics. Classify winner by frozen home win probability and compare signed projected margin separately. Use the fixed Week 11 confidence bands. Brier is mean squared home-win probability error; 0.25 is the uninformative 50/50 reference.
scope: Descriptive historical evaluation only. Not betting confidence, odds value, causal diagnosis, or production calibration. Week sizes differ and three-week outcomes warrant a prospective test.
